rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Happy Dog. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The kitchen serves hot dogs and burgers made by Blue Ribbon Meats, plus vegan dogs, on Orlando buns with plenty of toppings. Credit cards carry a 3% surcharge, debit cards don't, and table service during dinner depends on that night's events.
concessions.quote: Credit cards will be charged an additional 3% to help offset processing costs.
